_comment: The signup counterpart of login-id, and the visitor's first contact, so this title names the product.
loginActionText is the one paragraph under Continue, so the Terms and Privacy notice leads it and Auth0 appends the Log in link; the page escapes this text, so the URLs stay plain rather than links.
The page also collapses newlines, so non-breaking spaces join the words of Already have an account? to wrap it whole onto a line of its own.
